source_document: Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011 - Version II (09.11.2017), uploaded by the team
note: Amendments after this version are not loaded. Check fssai.gov.in before relying on any rule.

rules.summary: A licence or registration is valid for 1 to 5 years, as chosen by the operator, from the date of issue.
A renewal application is due at least 30 days before the expiry date on the licence.
A true copy of the licence must be displayed prominently in the business premises. This is a premises rule, not a pack-label rule.
Petty food businesses register; other food businesses need a licence. A pack does not show which applies.
A licence for which renewal was not applied for in time expires, so a printed number alone does not prove it is current.
